title: Rich People, Poor People
synopsis: This is the first part of our rendition of O. Henry’s short story “Lost on Dress Parade”.

fullText.simplified:
有钱人、没钱人（一）

    谢小北住在一个很小的房子里。因为他很高，所以他不喜欢小房子。但是他只能住在小房子里，因为他没有钱。
    他在一个公司工作，每个月有三千块钱。他喜欢每个月用两千八百块钱吃饭，还有两百块钱，他不用。一个月两百块钱，十个月就有两千块钱。
    等到有两千块钱的时候，就是他最快乐的时候。因为每到那个时候，他就会穿上他最好的衣服，用这两千块钱，去最好的饭店，和有钱人坐在一起，吃最贵的东西。那个时候，他觉得他就是有钱人。那个时候是他最快乐的时候。
    等了十个月，谢小北有了两千块钱。这天晚上，他穿上他最贵的衣服，要去最好的饭店吃饭。
    谢小北走在路上，他觉得他就是有钱人，他很快乐。他走到饭店的时候，看到一个女孩摔倒了。
（未完待续）
fullText.traditional:
有錢人、沒錢人（一）

    謝小北住在一個很小的房子裡。因為他很高，所以他不喜歡小房子。但是他只能住在小房子裡，因為他沒有錢。
    他在一個公司工作，每個月有三千塊錢。他喜歡每個月用兩千八百塊錢吃飯，還有兩百塊錢，他不用。一個月兩百塊錢，十個月就有兩千塊錢。
    等到有兩千塊錢的時候，就是他最快樂的時候。因為每到那個時候，他就會穿上他最好的衣服，用這兩千塊錢，去最好的飯店，和有錢人坐在一起，吃最貴的東西。那個時候，他覺得他就是有錢人。那個時候是他最快樂的時候。
    等了十個月，謝小北有了兩千塊錢。這天晚上，他穿上他最貴的衣服，要去最好的飯店吃飯。
    謝小北走在路上，他覺得他就是有錢人，他很快樂。他走到飯店的時候，看到一個女孩摔倒了。
（未完待續）

sentences.simplified: 谢小北住在一个很小的房子里。因为他很高，所以他不喜欢小房子。
sentences.traditional: 謝小北住在一個很小的房子裡。因為他很高，所以他不喜歡小房子。
sentences.pinyin: xiè xiǎo běi zhù zài yí ge hěn xiǎo de fáng zi lǐ yīn wèi tā hěn gāo suǒ yǐ tā bù xǐ huan xiǎo fáng zi
sentences.english: Xie Xiaobei lived in a very small apartment. Because he was very tall, he didn’t like the small apartment.

sentences.simplified: 但是他只能住在小房子里，因为他没有钱。
sentences.traditional: 但是他只能住在小房子裡，因為他沒有錢。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì tā zhǐ néng zhù zài xiǎo fáng zi lǐ yīn wèi tā méi yǒu qián
sentences.english: But he had no other choice but to live in a small apartment, because he didn’t have any money.

sentences.simplified: 他在一个公司工作，每个月有三千块钱。
sentences.traditional: 他在一個公司工作，每個月有三千塊錢。
sentences.pinyin: tā zài yí ge gōng sī gōng zuò měi ge yuè yǒu sān qiān kuài qián
sentences.english: He worked at a company, and got 3000 yuan every month.

sentences.simplified: 他喜欢每个月用两千八百块钱吃饭，还有两百块钱，他不用。
sentences.traditional: 他喜歡每個月用兩千八百塊錢吃飯，還有兩百塊錢，他不用。
sentences.pinyin: tā xǐ huan měi ge yuè yòng liǎng qiān bā bǎi kuài qián chī fàn hái yǒu liǎng bǎi kuài qián tā bú yòng
sentences.english: He liked to eat for 2800 every month. The additional 200 yuan, he didn’t spend.

sentences.simplified: 一个月两百块钱，十个月就有两千块钱。
sentences.traditional: 一個月兩百塊錢，十個月就有兩千塊錢。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge yuè liǎng bǎi kuài qián shí ge yuè jiù yǒu liǎng qiān kuài qián
sentences.english: 200 yuan one month, that was 2000 yuan in ten months.

sentences.simplified: 等到有两千块钱的时候，就是他最快乐的时候。
sentences.traditional: 等到有兩千塊錢的時候，就是他最快樂的時候。
sentences.pinyin: děng dào yǒu liǎng qiān kuài qián de shí hou jiù shì tā zuì kuài lè de shí hou
sentences.english: By the time he had 2000 yuan, that’s when he was happiest.

sentences.simplified: 因为每到那个时候，他就会穿上他最好的衣服，
sentences.traditional: 因為每到那個時候，他就會穿上他最好的衣服，
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi měi dào nà ge shí hou tā jiù huì chuān shang tā zuì hǎo de yī fu
sentences.english: Because every time that happened, he would put on his best clothes, ..

sentences.simplified: 用这两千块钱，去最好的饭店，和有钱人坐在一起，吃最贵的东西。
sentences.traditional: 用這兩千塊錢，去最好的飯店，和有錢人坐在一起，吃最貴的東西。
sentences.pinyin: yòng zhè liǎng qiān kuài qián qù zuì hǎo de fàn diàn hé yǒu qián rén zuò zài yì qǐ chī zuì guì de dōng xi
sentences.english: .. use these 2000 yuan to go to the finest restaurant, and sit together with rich people eating the most expensive things.

sentences.simplified: 那个时候，他觉得他就是有钱人。那个时候是他最快乐的时候。
sentences.traditional: 那個時候，他覺得他就是有錢人。那個時候是他最快樂的時候。
sentences.pinyin: nà ge shí hou tā jué de tā jiù shì yǒu qián rén nà ge shí hou shì tā zuì kuài lè de shí hou
sentences.english: At these times, he felt like he was someone rich. These times were his happiest times.

sentences.simplified: 等了十个月，谢小北有了两千块钱。
sentences.traditional: 等了十個月，謝小北有了兩千塊錢。
sentences.pinyin: děng le shí ge yuè xiè xiǎo běi yǒu le liǎng qiān kuài qián
sentences.english: After waiting for ten months, Xie Xiaobei had 2000 yuan.

sentences.simplified: 这天晚上，他穿上他最贵的衣服，要去最好的饭店吃饭。
sentences.traditional: 這天晚上，他穿上他最貴的衣服，要去最好的飯店吃飯。
sentences.pinyin: zhè tiān wǎn shang tā chuān shang tā zuì guì de yī fu yào qù zuì hǎo de fàn diàn chī fàn
sentences.english: This evening, he put on his most expensive clothes and was going to the finest restaurant to eat.

sentences.simplified: 谢小北走在路上，他觉得他就是有钱人，他很快乐。
sentences.traditional: 謝小北走在路上，他覺得他就是有錢人，他很快樂。
sentences.pinyin: xiè xiǎo běi zǒu zài lù shang tā jué de tā jiù shì yǒu qián rén tā hěn kuài lè
sentences.english: Xie Xiaobei was walking on his way. He felt like he was someone rich, and was very happy.

sentences.simplified: 他走到饭店的时候，看到一个女孩摔倒了。
sentences.traditional: 他走到飯店的時候，看到一個女孩摔倒了。
sentences.pinyin: tā zǒu dào fàn diàn de shí hou kàn dào yí ge nǚ hái shuāi dǎo le
sentences.english: When he arrived at the restaurant, he saw a girl fall over.

raw.synopsis: This is the first part of our rendition of O. Henry’s short story “Lost on Dress Parade”.
sentence_translations: Xie Xiaobei lived in a very small apartment. Because he was very tall, he didn’t like the small apartment.
But he had no other choice but to live in a small apartment, because he didn’t have any money.
He worked at a company, and got 3000 yuan every month.
He liked to eat for 2800 every month. The additional 200 yuan, he didn’t spend.
200 yuan one month, that was 2000 yuan in ten months.
By the time he had 2000 yuan, that’s when he was happiest.
Because every time that happened, he would put on his best clothes, ..
.. use these 2000 yuan to go to the finest restaurant, and sit together with rich people eating the most expensive things.
At these times, he felt like he was someone rich. These times were his happiest times.
After waiting for ten months, Xie Xiaobei had 2000 yuan.
This evening, he put on his most expensive clothes and was going to the finest restaurant to eat.
Xie Xiaobei was walking on his way. He felt like he was someone rich, and was very happy.
When he arrived at the restaurant, he saw a girl fall over.
